question: Why do eclipses and great pilgrimage sites override ordinary timing rules for initiation?
premises: An eclipse is a special occasion.
A great pilgrimage site is a special place.
In these cases there is no fixed determination of time.
inference: During eclipses and at great pilgrimage sites, ordinary time restrictions do not apply.
plain_english: In an eclipse and at a great pilgrimage site, there is no fixed determination of time.
